## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. State any API, evidence or solver-version changes.

## Validation

List actual checks and outcomes. Distinguish core tests, archive scoring, new simulations
and numerical qualification.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change
- [ ] Evidence, solver and dependency provenance remain accurate
- [ ] Acceptance claims match the selected qualification policy
- [ ] New dependencies have documented licenses and retained notices
